overview.title: Overview
overview.onlineHint: Users with the app open right now
overview.filesHint: Avatars and files in messages, not the database

users.title: Users
users.disableExplain: This user is logged out at once and can't log in again. The account, friends and chat history are kept and come back when you enable it.
users.enableExplain: This user will be able to log in again, with everything as it was.
users.resetExplain: A temporary password is generated and every current login of this user ends. After logging in with it, the user must set a new password first.
users.resetDoneExplain: This password is shown only once. Copy it now and pass it on to {{name}}.
users.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select it and copy manually.

inviteCodes.title: Invite codes
inviteCodes.emptyHint: Choose how many above, then select Generate
inviteCodes.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please select the code and copy it yourself.
inviteCodes.revokeExplain: After this, {{code}} can no longer be used to register. This can't be undone.
inviteCodes.revokeSelectedExplain: After this, these codes can no longer be used to register. This can't be undone.
inviteCodes.revokedSome: Revoked {{revoked}}; {{skipped}} more had already been used or revoked
inviteCodes.deleteExplain: After this, {{code}} is gone from the list. This can't be undone.
inviteCodes.deleteSelectedTitle_one: Delete {{count}} revoked or expired invite code?
inviteCodes.deleteSelectedTitle_other: Delete {{count}} revoked or expired invite codes?
inviteCodes.deleteSelectedExplain: After this, they are gone from the list. This can't be undone.
inviteCodes.orderHint: Sorted by creation time. Click to reverse.

chats.title: Chat records
chats.explain: Find a user first, then pick one of their conversations. To find a group by name, use Groups. Opening a conversation is recorded in the audit log.
chats.search: Find a user by ID or nickname
chats.noConversations: This user has no conversations yet

viewer.bannerDetail: Read-only. This view has been recorded in the audit log.
viewer.empty: There are no messages in this conversation
viewer.expired: This view has lasted more than 30 minutes. Continuing adds a new entry to the audit log.

groups.title: Groups
groups.dissolveExplain: Nobody will be able to send messages in it any more; the history is kept. Every member sees that the group was dissolved by an administrator. This can't be undone.

settings.title: System settings
settings.groupMax: Maximum group size (members, including the owner)
settings.recallHint: How long after sending a message can be recalled. 0 turns recalling off.
settings.retention: How long chat history and files are kept
settings.retentionWarning: Messages and files past this period are cleaned up once a day. They are deleted permanently and can't be recovered.
settings.saved: Saved. The new settings are in effect.
settings.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
settings.callVideoHint: Takes effect from the next call. A sharper picture uses more of the network.
settings.screenMaxFps: Shared screen: maximum frame rate (frames per second)
settings.screenDirectMbps: Shared screen, direct connection: maximum bitrate (Mbps)
settings.screenRelayMbps: Shared screen, through the relay: maximum bitrate (Mbps)
settings.cameraRelayMbps: Camera, through the relay: maximum bitrate (Mbps)
settings.relayHint: Every call through the relay uses this much of the server's outgoing bandwidth; check that the server has enough before raising it.
settings.editHint: How long after sending a message can be edited. 0 turns editing off.
settings.groupCallHint: The most people who can be in a group voice call at once. Every extra person means more audio for the server to forward when everyone talks, so it uses more outbound bandwidth; check the server has enough before raising it.
settings.groupVideoHint: In a group video call everyone sends two tiers at once, a clear one (640×360) and a small one (320×180), and the server forwards only one of them to each viewer: the enlarged picture is the clear one, the others are small. People who join after a change send with the new numbers.
settings.groupVideoEstimate_one: With these numbers: a group call with {{count}} person, camera on, makes the server send out about {{mbps}} Mbps of pictures at most (sound not included).
settings.groupVideoEstimate_other: With these numbers: a group call with {{count}} people, all with cameras on, makes the server send out about {{mbps}} Mbps of pictures at most (sound not included). Several groups in video calls at once add up. Check that the server has the bandwidth before raising them.
settings.groupScreenEstimate_one: A screen shared in a group call is sent as one tier (at most 1920 pixels wide, 10 frames a second) and forwarded to everyone else in the call. With these numbers and {{count}} person in the call there is nobody to forward it to.
settings.groupScreenEstimate_other: A screen shared in a group call is sent as one tier (at most 1920 pixels wide, 10 frames a second) and forwarded to everyone else in the call. With these numbers: in a video call with {{count}} people, one sharing and the others with cameras on, the server sends out about {{video}} Mbps of pictures at most; in a voice call, about {{voice}} Mbps. A screen that isn't moving uses far less. Too low a bitrate makes text hard to read.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.explain: Everything the administrator does is recorded here. Entries can be read but not changed or deleted.

entry.chat_viewed_group: Viewed the chat of the group “{{label}}”
entry.password_reset: Reset the password of the user {{label}}

setting.screen_relay_kbps: Shared screen bitrate, through the relay
setting.group_screen_kbps: Shared screen bitrate in group calls
